title: Jolly Juicy Croatian Kabanos Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Croatian stew featuring Polish kabanos, with a mustardy and cheesy flavor profile, perfect for a sick day. This dish is also ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and incorporates mushimono-steam cooking techniques.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced kabanos and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the chopped carrot and potato, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the mustard, cheese, and vegetable broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use a steamer basket to steam the stew for an additional 10 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Let the stew cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
